messages:
lee: heads up — planning a canary rollout for model v7.1. goal: percent+region ramp (min disruption). plan proposal below, want quick sign-offs and any missing guardrails.

lee: high-level plan:
- 1% EU-west (user-facing) + 1% NA-east for 30m
- if metrics stable (p95 latency, error_rate) -> 5% region after 60m
- 25% global after 6h, then gradual to 100% over 24h

lee: config I'm going to apply (infra flag):
```yaml
feature_flag: mosaic_v7_1_canary
slices:
  - name: eu_smoke
    pct: 1
    regions: [eu-west-1]
    routes: ["/chat", "/completion"]
  - name: na_seed
    pct: 1
    regions: [us-east-1]
    routes: ["/chat"]
fallback: v7.0
abort_conditions:
  p95_latency_ms: 450 # abort if p95 > 450ms for 5m
  error_rate_pct: 0.5 # abort if error rate > 0.5% for 5m
rollout_timing:
  initial_hold_minutes: 30
  evaluate_window_minutes: 30
  next_step_minutes: 60
notifications:
  pagerduty: oncall-sre
  slack_channel: eng-oncall
```

tasha: a couple quick asks: 1) exclude internal-admin routes (we don't want test traffic skew) 2) ensure request sampling tag `canary:mosaic_v7_1` is present for tracing + eval.

lee: good calls — I'll add `exclude_routes: ["/admin", "/internal/*"]` and the sampling header.

ryan: quick note on runtime: add sticky routing for KV-cache warmup on the first 1000 requests for each slice, otherwise p95 will bounce. also add a model-variant fallback map: if v7.1 returns malformed output or safety trigger, route that user to v7.0 for next 5 minutes.

oncall-sre: put this in the runbook brief: if error_rate_pct breaches 0.5% or p95 > 450ms for >= 5m, run `ffctl disable mosaic_v7_1_canary` and escalate. PD integration already configured?

lee: yes PD is wired. I'll add an automation: if both conditions are true, infra-bot will auto-disable and post reasons.

infra-bot: planned change queued:
```
apply-flag mosaic_v7_1_canary --slices eu_smoke=1,na_seed=1 --exclude /admin,/internal/* --tags canary:mosaic_v7_1
```
deploy-bot: flag mosaic_v7_1_canary created @1725554500 and staged to policy 'staged-apply'. will apply at 1725554600 unless cancelled. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

tasha: PR for telemetry and alert tweeks? ping me when it's up, I'll review.

lee: opening PR now -> https://git.redwood/cfg/infra/+/2345 (includes alerts + sampling header + exclude routes). please comment.

ryan: quick code-review ask: add a metric `mosaic.v7_1.fallback_count` so we can track fallback frequency. tiny change.

lee: will add metric to PR.

oncall-sre: reminder: add a dashboard tile for these signals (p95, error_rate, fallback_count, token_cost delta). we need a one-glance abort indicator.

tasha: thumbs-up, adding to my dashboard todo.

lee: final ask — any objections to the timing? planning to start staging apply in ~15m from now.

ryan: no objections from infra side. :+1:

tasha: no objections. go ahead. :rocket:

infra-bot: applying canary slices now -> mosaic_v7_1_canary :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: applied at 1725554600 — monitoring hooks enabled.

lee: thanks all. will monitor first 30m and paste quick notes.

lee: (30m update) EU 1% -> p95=320ms, error_rate=0.03%, fallback_count=0. good so far. moving to 5% region after 10m.

ryan: nice. I'll watch kv-cache heat and sticky behavior.

oncall-sre: keeping pagerduty on alert.

lee: (1h update) 5% region stab: p95=340ms, error_rate=0.05%, fallback_count=2 (both safety triggers). manual inspect shows safety filter behaving correctly. proceeding to 25% in next 2h unless issues. :eyes:

tasha: thanks for the updates — copy that.

lee: end of thread — will create retro note after full ramp.
